items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Charlie Barnet, Mel Powell, Harry Babasin... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, that's Buck and Bubbles.

ctx.x: I guess you did. And I bet you this picture is from that one, because it looks like one of those sets. Is it?

No. There's a blond young lady in front of the band there. This -- Harry Babasin on bass. It's very difficult to tell. This looks like -- let me get just a little more light on the subject here, and we'll see what we've got here.
There's more films listed. I haven't mentioned these two yet.
